subject: Arcadia: inspection windows, pen-test rules, and evidence rotation for MSA security exhibit
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice@arcadialabs.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@arcadialabs.com
Date: 2027-05-09T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft security exhibit — SOC2 / pen-test language + evidence cadence

Hi Tessa / Marissa,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We are preparing the final MSA and want to align on the security exhibit before legal signs off. Two quick asks we need clarified in writing:

1) SOC 2: We need confirmation of the latest SOC 2 Type II report availability (PDF) and a commitment to provide the next annual report within 30 days of issuance.

2) Pen test / inspection rights: Our security team requests a documented pen-test window and a minimal inspection access plan (who/what can test, whether production can be tested, allowable techniques, and coordination SLA). We prefer a 14-day advance notice for live tests, but open to negotiation.

3) Evidence cadence: We're asking for a monthly evidence snapshot for a rolling 90-day window covering retention, encryption config, and sample access logs for authentication/authorization events. If full exports are not possible, we'd accept time-boxed, read-only sessions.

I attached our security questionnaire (Arcadia_Security_Questions.xlsx) with highlighted must-haves. Please propose redline language and confirm whether the suggested evidence cadence is feasible.

Goal: lock language in the Order Form / Exhibit this week so procurement can issue the PO.

Thanks,

Alice Park
Head of Security, Arcadia Labs
alice@arcadialabs.com

Attachments: Arcadia_Security_Questions.xlsx

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice@arcadialabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft security exhibit — SOC2 / pen-test language + evidence cadence

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We want to be cooperative but need to balance operational constraints and other customers' privacy. High-level proposal (we attached a quick redline draft): redlines-draft.docx

Proposed compromises:
- SOC 2: We will provide the latest SOC 2 Type II PDF within 3 business days of request and commit to delivering future reports within 30 days of issuance; standard NDA/PO required.
- Pen tests: 30-day notice for production tests (we can shorten to 14 days for critical partners by exception). Tests are limited to agreed IP ranges and scopes; no destructive techniques (e.g., production data destruction). We require an escrowed point of contact and a scoped statement of work for the tester.
- Evidence: Instead of full raw log exports, we can offer either (a) monthly evidence snapshots (sanitized) for a rolling 90-day window OR (b) a monitored, time-boxed remote read-only session where our engineer shares logs and supporting artifacts in real time.

Quick asks for you: please confirm which option (sanitized snapshots vs read-only session) you prefer, and provide a primary tester contact and their ATO/PCI background if you intend to test production.

Next steps: I can loop in our infra on the call — propose a 30-min sync tomorrow. Redlines are attached and linked here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-redwood-arcadia

Thanks,
Tessa
Director, Customer Ops — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redlines-draft.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Alice Park <alice@arcadialabs.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft security exhibit — SOC2 / pen-test language + evidence cadence

Alice / Tessa — legal + compliance weigh-in. A few clarifications and a firm alternative we need to include in the exhibit to keep scope bounded: see attached evidence-matrix.csv for mapping.

Key points from Legal:
- No unfettered access: we cannot permit raw log export or continuous access to production systems. All access must be time-limited, monitored, and either screen-shared or executed in a read-only, audit-tracked environment.
- Pen-test approvals: require signed SOW for the tester plus proof of insurance and a designated primary technical contact at Arcadia. We will accept a 30-day notice by default; for critical partners we can add language for a 14-day expedited review subject to an internal change control checklist.
- In-scope assets: please confirm whether Arcadia intends to include production DBs, S3 buckets with PII, and ML model endpoints. If any of these are in-scope, we need to include an additional security attestation clause and a brief runbook for safe testing.

Suggested exhibit language snippets (to be inserted into Section 5 of the Exhibit):
- "Inspection sessions shall be scheduled, time-boxed (max 4 hours per session without prior agreement), and recorded. Redwood will provide sanitized logs and a summary report. Access to raw logs requires a separate inspection agreement."
- "Pen-test activities against production require a minimum 30-day notice, explicit scope, and agreement on techniques. Denial-of-service or destructive techniques are expressly prohibited without prior written consent."

If Arcadia is ok with the two-option evidence approach (monthly sanitized snapshot OR remote read-only session), we can consolidate language and finalize. Otherwise Legal will push for the latter option only.

I'll be on the sync tomorrow.

—Marissa
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-matrix.csv

From: Alice Park <alice@arcadialabs.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft security exhibit — SOC2 / pen-test language + evidence cadence

Tessa / Marissa — thanks for the quick turn. Arcadia accepts the two-option evidence approach and will initially choose the monthly sanitized snapshots for the first 90 days while we complete onboarding. Follow-ups:

- Scope confirmation: production authentication logs, API gateway logs, and the application auth database (read-only) are in-scope. We do NOT need model training data.
- Pen tests: we can accept 30-day notice by default. We will provide tester SOW, insurance, and a point of contact.
- SOC2: request for the latest Type II PDF this morning — please send via SSO-protected link.

Attached is the PO for the first quarter (arcadia_po_456.pdf). Let's lock the redline language into the Order Form and sign. If helpful, I'm available for a 30-min call this afternoon to finalize.

Best,
Alice Park
Head of Security, Arcadia Labs

Attachments: arcadia_po_456.pdf
